response.sql:
WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT MediaTypeId,
         AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
         SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(Milliseconds) AS byte_rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
), rates_with_average AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(byte_rate) OVER () AS cross_media_type_avg_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price,
       AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate,
       AVG(byte_rate - cross_media_type_avg_rate) AS avg_excess_byte_rate
FROM rates_with_average
WHERE byte_rate > cross_media_type_avg_rate;

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded from the byte sum, as in standard SQL; all tracks remain in the media-type group and millisecond sum. The simple average across media types includes each Track.MediaTypeId group, with no rounding.
